Moving our community off the open source release

Updates to the open source release stop at the end of the year, so we need to decide where this community goes next. Staying put means running software that no longer gets security fixes, which is not something we want to do for long.

The two options on the table are the hosted plan or a migration to another open source forum. I would like to hear from anyone who has moved a community of a few thousand members before we vote next month.

  • ana

    We migrated last spring and kept every thread and member account, but plan a weekend for redirects.

  • teo

    The hosted plan priced us out at our size, so ask for a quote before the vote.
